scoring.verdicts: 每条判定独立二元；部分满足即判否。连续分 = Σ(通过判定权重) / Σ(非 na 判定权重) × 100（总权重 100；X04 权重 0 不计）。
scoring.group_gate_rule: 组门槛判定失败，则该组其余判定全部记 0（门槛判定本身仍按自身结果计）；不影响其他组。
scoring.task_gates: 整题门槛：base/output.mp4 缺失或不满足 B01 编码契约时，postprocess 在报告 aux 中记 _task_gate = fail（“验收失败”），连续分照常报告。作弊（联网、读隐藏文件等）不在评分程序内检测。
scoring.acceptance: 全部判定通过才算 Perfect。
scoring.judge: 只有 M12（文本部分）、X07（外观部分）与 X09 交由 LLM 评委按证据判 pass/fail；其余判定由 checks.py 确定性给出。无人工盲审环节；评分镜像缺 blender 时工程相关判定记 error，不发奖励。
scoring.measure_on_declared: 动作与台词时刻一律按 events.csv 声明帧测量，配合 B05 的合理性规则；剪辑点、J-cut 提前量、修订帧数为公开规格。
scoring.bone_identification: 骨名不作规定，checks.py 按名称关键词识别：头骨 = 名为 head（单词）或 spine.006 的骨（优先变形骨）；下颌/口型 = 名含 jaw/mouth/lip/chin/teeth/tongue 的骨、名含 jaw/mouth/viseme/lip/open 等的形态键、名含 jaw/mouth 的角色子物体；手部骨链 = 名含 hand/palm/finger/thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky/f_ 的骨（优先变形骨）；左右侧按 .L/.R、_l/_r、left/right。
scoring.project_measurement: 工程测量：评分方用 blender -b 只读打开 project/scene.blend，将 rev1_hold_frames、rev2_trim_frames 设为 0（base 状态），逐帧（影片第 i 帧 = frame_start + i）导出对象/骨骼/形态键/材质发射/摄影机数据；第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk。

items.criterion_zh: 三版成片编码契约：base 900 帧、rev1 912 帧、rev2 903 帧；H.264 yuv420p 1280×720 方形像素、恒定 30 fps；AAC 立体声 48 kHz，音频覆盖全部画面。
items.criterion_en: Encoding contract for all three films: 900 / 912 / 903 frames; H.264 yuv420p 1280x720 square pixels CFR 30; AAC stereo 48 kHz covering the picture.
items.verify: ffprobe -count_frames 解码计数；codec/pix_fmt/SAR/r_frame_rate/avg_frame_rate；音频时长 ≥ 画面时长 −1 帧。

items.criterion_zh: 母带：三版综合响度均在 −22.0 至 −18.0 LUFS；真峰值 ≤ −0.9 dBTP；无连续 ≥3 个满幅采样。
items.criterion_en: Master: integrated −22.0..−18.0 LUFS, true peak ≤ −0.9 dBTP, no run of ≥3 full-scale samples, all three versions.
items.verify: ffmpeg ebur128=peak=true；解码 PCM 统计 |x|≥0.999 连续段。

items.criterion_zh: 分轨契约（声音组门槛）：三版各有 stems/{studio,taxi,radio,phone}.wav，48 kHz PCM 立体声，长度与成片相差 ≤1 帧；按 timeline.json 声明增益相加后，与解码混音的 1/3 倍频程带能量（100 ms 帧）逐点差中位数 ≤ 0.75 dB、95 分位 ≤ 3 dB，且每条分轨的声明增益与最小二乘拟合增益（≤4 kHz）相差 ≤ 1 dB。
items.criterion_en: Stem contract (gate of group S): four 48 kHz stereo PCM stems per version, length within 1 frame; the declared-gain sum matches the decoded mix in 1/3-octave band energies (100 ms frames: median |diff| ≤ 0.75 dB, 95th percentile ≤ 3 dB) and every declared stem gain is within 1 dB of the least-squares fitted gain (≤ 4 kHz).
items.verify: checks.py：ffprobe 检查格式与长度；timeline.json 中名含 gain 的数值按 统一/master 线性|dB/逐轨 线性|dB 各种解读取最优；对齐 ≤2048 样本后比较 1/3 倍频程带能量；≤4 kHz 低通后最小二乘拟合各轨增益。（AAC 有损编码使波形残差不可达，故不用波形残差。）

items.criterion_zh: 镜头结构：base 在第 180/360/540/720 帧（±1）各有一处硬切，切点两侧无混合帧；其余位置无剪辑；无 ≥15 帧的定格：相邻帧 PSNR ≥ 55 dB 连续 ≥15 帧，且工程中该段所属镜头的 CAM_Sk（矩阵/焦距）与画内角色骨架（骨骼运动或口型通道）在该段内都没有变化。
items.criterion_en: Shot structure: hard cuts at frames 180/360/540/720 ±1 with no blend frames; no other cuts; no freeze: a run of ≥15 frames with adjacent-frame PSNR ≥ 55 dB counts as a freeze when, in the project, neither that shot's CAM_Sk (matrix/lens) nor any in-frame character rig (bone motion or mouth channels) changes during the run.
items.verify: checks.py：320×180 灰度逐帧，平均绝对差尖峰 + 32 档直方图变化检测剪辑，相邻帧差判断混合帧；PSNR 连续段作为定格候选，再用工程逐帧导出核对摄影机与画内角色是否有动画（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk）。

items.criterion_zh: events.csv：表头恰为 event_id,frame,description；16 个必需 id 齐全、帧为 0–899 整数；位置与顺序合理：line1 在 S1；line2_start 在 S1 且 line2_end 在 S2；knob_down_* 与 phone_at_ear 在 S2 且 knob_down_end < phone_at_ear ≤ line3_start；line3_start = 342±2；line3_end 在 S4 且 < caller_fader_down < line4_start（均在 S4）；line4_end、phone_hang_up、knob_up_*、light_green 在 S5 且 phone_hang_up < knob_up_start。
items.criterion_en: events.csv header exact; 16 ids; integer frames; shot membership and ordering as specified (line3_start = 342±2; line3_end < caller_fader_down < line4_start in S4; etc.).
items.verify: csv 解析 + 规则表核对。

items.criterion_zh: 工程契约（场景组门槛）：project/scene.blend 由 Blender 4.3 保存（文件版本 4.3.x）且可后台打开；3 个人物、3 个骨架（*_RIG 均为 Armature）、10 个道具、CAM_S1–CAM_S5 全部按名存在；场景属性 rev1_hold_frames、rev2_trim_frames 存在；README 含 blender -b 导出命令；credits.md、qa.md 存在。
items.criterion_en: Project contract (gate of group P): project/scene.blend was saved by Blender 4.3 (file version 4.3.x) and opens headless; all named characters, rigs (the *_RIG objects are armatures), props and CAM_S1–CAM_S5 exist; both revision properties exist; README contains a blender -b export command; credits.md and qa.md exist.
items.verify: checks.py：blender -b scene.blend --python（只读）导出对象名/类型、场景属性与 bpy.data.version；评分镜像缺 blender 时记 error（不发奖励）。

items.criterion_zh: 台词时刻：四条分轨相加后，在 300–3400 Hz 语音频带包络（20 ms 窗、10 ms 步）上，每句实测起止与 events.csv 声明的 line*_start/line*_end 相差 ≤ 6 帧：声明起点 ±0.2 s 内有语音活动，且（前一句未紧邻时）起点前 0.2–0.45 s 无活动；终点同理。活动阈值 = max(全片 10 分位底噪 + 15 dB, 该句峰值 − 35 dB)。（可懂度不再单独评分。）
items.criterion_en: Speech timing: on the summed stems (300–3400 Hz envelope, 20 ms window, 10 ms hop) every line's measured onset/offset is within 6 frames of the declared line*_start/line*_end in events.csv: activity within ±0.2 s of the declared point and (unless the neighbouring line is adjacent) no activity 0.2–0.45 s before the start / after the end. Activity threshold = max(film 10th-percentile floor + 15 dB, line peak − 35 dB). (Intelligibility is not scored separately.)
items.verify: checks.py 确定性测量；不再用 ASR（评分镜像无 ASR 模型）。

items.criterion_zh: T23 J-cut：taxi 分轨上司机语音起点（300–3400 Hz 包络持续 ≥50 ms 超过阈值 max(底噪+15 dB, 峰值−35 dB)）= 11.40 ± 0.05 s，11.00–11.35 s 无此类语音活动；342–359 帧中 DRIVER 嘴部在每帧要么不可见（头骨中点投影在 CAM_S2 画外，或头部前向与“头→摄影机”水平方向夹角 > 100°），要么 DRIVER 口型通道与 taxi 分轨逐帧包络相关 r ≥ 0.5（滞后 ≤ 2 帧）。
items.criterion_en: T23 J-cut: on the taxi stem the driver's speech onset (300–3400 Hz envelope above max(floor+15 dB, peak−35 dB) for ≥50 ms) is 11.40 ±0.05 s with no such activity in 11.00–11.35 s; in frames 342–359 the DRIVER's mouth is unseen in every frame (head-bone midpoint projects outside CAM_S2, or the head's front direction is >100° from the head→camera direction) or the DRIVER mouth channel correlates with the per-frame taxi-stem envelope at r ≥ 0.5 (lag ≤ 2 frames).
items.verify: checks.py：分轨包络 + 工程逐帧导出（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk）；头部前向取下颌骨（头→下巴）水平方向，无下颌骨时取面部骨（eye/nose/lip…）重心方向。

items.criterion_zh: T12 视点切换：L2 在 studio 分轨上不晚于 6.05 s 结束、在 radio 分轨上不早于 5.95 s 开始（源分轨最后一个、目标分轨第一个“高于各自峰值 −30 dB”的 10 ms 帧，300–3400 Hz），二者间隙 ≤ 0.40 s、重叠 ≤ 0.05 s；6.10–12.00 s studio 分轨 ≤ −55 dBFS（10 ms RMS）；剪辑点处无爆音：四轨相加信号在 6.00 s ±10 ms 内的 24 阶线性预测残差峰值不超过 ±60 ms 邻域残差峰值 12 dB。（跳字/重复词无 ASR，不单独测量，由间隙上限约束。）
items.criterion_en: T12 perspective switch: L2 leaves the studio stem no later than 6.05 s and enters the radio stem no earlier than 5.95 s (last/first 10 ms frame above each stem's peak −30 dB, 300–3400 Hz), with gap ≤ 0.40 s and overlap ≤ 0.05 s; studio stem ≤ −55 dBFS (10 ms RMS) in 6.10–12.00 s; no click: on the summed stems the order-24 linear-prediction residual peak within ±10 ms of 6.00 s is not more than 12 dB above the residual peak in the rest of ±60 ms. (Dropped/repeated words are not measured without ASR; the gap limit bounds them.)
items.verify: checks.py 确定性测量（分轨包络、电平、线性预测残差）。

items.criterion_zh: T45 视点切换：与 M03 同口径，L4 在 24.00 s 处 studio → radio：studio 不晚于 24.05 s 结束、radio 不早于 23.95 s 开始，间隙 ≤ 0.40 s、重叠 ≤ 0.05 s；24.10–30.00 s studio 分轨 ≤ −55 dBFS；24.00 s 处无爆音（同 M03 判据）。
items.criterion_en: T45 perspective switch, same method as M03 for L4 at 24.00 s: studio ends ≤ 24.05 s, radio starts ≥ 23.95 s, gap ≤ 0.40 s, overlap ≤ 0.05 s; studio stem ≤ −55 dBFS in 24.10–30.00 s; no click at 24.00 s (M03 criterion).
items.verify: 同 M03。

items.criterion_zh: T34 L-cut 转电话：L3 在 taxi 分轨上不晚于 18.05 s 结束、在 phone 分轨上不早于 17.95 s 开始（M03 口径），间隙 ≤ 0.40 s、重叠 ≤ 0.05 s；18.20–24.00 s taxi 分轨 ≤ −55 dBFS；phone 分轨 0–17.95 s ≤ −50 dBFS；phone 分轨上 L3 的最后活动不早于声明 line3_end − 0.2 s；18.00 s 处无爆音（M03 判据）。
items.criterion_en: T34 L-cut to phone: L3 leaves the taxi stem ≤ 18.05 s and enters the phone stem ≥ 17.95 s (M03 method), gap ≤ 0.40 s, overlap ≤ 0.05 s; taxi stem ≤ −55 dBFS in 18.20–24.00 s; phone stem ≤ −50 dBFS in 0–17.95 s; the phone stem carries L3 until at least declared line3_end − 0.2 s; no click at 18.00 s (M03 criterion).
items.verify: 同 M03。

items.criterion_zh: 收音机旋钮因果：RADIO_KNOB 相对 RADIO 的旋转在 knob_down_start–knob_down_end 与 knob_up_start–knob_up_end 内各单调（容差 0.5°）转过 ≥ 30°，其余时段（窗口外 ±2 帧以外）转动 ≤ 3°；两次转动开始（±2 帧）时 DRIVER 手部骨链（名含 hand/palm/finger/thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky/f_ 的骨段）距旋钮原点 ≤ 6 cm；radio 分轨短时响度（K 加权 400 ms 窗的最大值）：结束点后 0.5–1.0 s 比开始前 0.5 s 至开始前 3 帧，调低时低 ≥ 6 LU、调高时高 ≥ 6 LU。
items.criterion_en: Radio knob causality: RADIO_KNOB rotation relative to RADIO turns monotonically (0.5° tolerance) by ≥30° within each declared knob window and ≤3° elsewhere (outside the windows ±2 frames); at each turn start (±2 frames) a DRIVER hand-chain bone segment is within 6 cm of the knob origin; radio-stem short-term loudness (K-weighted 400 ms, max over windows ending 0.5–1.0 s after the turn end vs 0.5 s to 3 frames before the turn start) is ≥6 LU lower after knob_down and ≥6 LU higher after knob_up.
items.verify: checks.py：工程逐帧导出（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk） + 分轨短时响度。

items.criterion_zh: 电话与推子：phone_at_ear 至 min(line3_end, 539) 每帧 PHONE 原点距 DRIVER 头骨骨段 ≤ 12 cm、距 DRIVER 手部骨链 ≤ 6 cm；CALLER_FADER 在 caller_fader_down −3 与 +3 帧之间平移 ≥ 1 cm，且 caller_fader_down −3 帧至该帧内 HOST_B 手部骨链距其 ≤ 5 cm；phone 分轨自 caller_fader_down +3 帧起 ≤ −60 dBFS。
items.criterion_en: Phone and fader: from phone_at_ear to min(line3_end, 539) the PHONE origin is within 12 cm of the DRIVER head-bone segment and within 6 cm of a DRIVER hand-chain bone in every frame; CALLER_FADER moves ≥1 cm between caller_fader_down −3 and +3 frames with a HOST_B hand-chain bone within 5 cm of it in the 3 frames before; phone stem ≤ −60 dBFS from caller_fader_down +3 frames.
items.verify: checks.py：工程逐帧导出（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk） + 分轨电平。

items.criterion_zh: 镜头参数（工程逐帧）：S1 俯仰 ±10° 内、位移 < 1 cm、焦距 28–70 mm 不变；S2/S5 焦距在 24–70 mm，且有手持抖动：去除 15 帧滑动平均后的位置残差峰值 1–60 mm（或位置残差 < 1 mm 时朝向残差 0.05–3°），且非周期（残差自相关在首次过零后 60 帧内回升不到 0.6）；S3 位移 < 1 cm、焦距不变、景深开启且 f ≤ 4；S4 摄影机到 HOST_B 头骨的距离从第 540 帧到第 719 帧缩短 ≥ 0.08 m、焦距不变、景深开启且 f ≤ 4。
items.criterion_en: Camera data (per frame from the project): S1 pitch within ±10°, travel < 1 cm, constant 28–70 mm lens; S2/S5 lens within 24–70 mm with handheld shake: position residual after a 15-frame moving average peaks at 1–60 mm (or, if < 1 mm, orientation residual 0.05–3°) and is non-periodic (its autocorrelation does not climb back to ≥0.6 within 60 frames after the first zero crossing); S3 travel < 1 cm, constant lens, DOF on with f ≤ 4; S4 camera-to-HOST_B-head distance shrinks ≥0.08 m from frame 540 to 719, constant lens, DOF on with f ≤ 4.
items.verify: checks.py：工程逐帧导出 CAM_S* 矩阵、lens、dof（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk）。

items.criterion_zh: rev1：912 帧；0–341 帧与 base 一致（每 19 帧抽样 PSNR ≥ 30）；rev1 第 372/462/642/822 帧与 base 第 360/450/630/810 帧 PSNR ≥ 30；T23 在第 372±1 帧硬切；四条分轨 0–11.38 s 与 base 相关 ≥ 0.99（两者皆静音则免）；12.4 s 起每条非静音分轨（200–4000 Hz）与 base 的互相关最大值所在滞后 = +0.400 ± 0.010 s 且相关 ≥ 0.5；rev1 taxi 分轨 L3 起点（M02 口径）= 11.80 ± 0.05 s。（同一 .blend 出三版，工程属性取值不在此核对，属性存在由 B06 检查。）
items.criterion_en: rev1: 912 frames; frames 0–341 equal base (PSNR ≥ 30 every 19 frames); rev1 frames 372/462/642/822 match base 360/450/630/810 (PSNR ≥ 30); hard cut at 372±1; every stem correlates ≥0.99 with base over 0–11.38 s (both silent is fine); from 12.4 s every non-silent stem (200–4000 Hz) is base delayed by +0.400 ±0.010 s (cross-correlation peak, r ≥ 0.5); rev1 taxi-stem L3 onset (M02 method) 11.80 ±0.05 s. (One .blend serves all versions, so the property values are not checked here; their presence is B06.)
items.verify: checks.py：PSNR 抽样、剪辑检测、分轨相关与 FFT 互相关、起点检测。

items.criterion_zh: 工程即真实来源：评分方以 base 属性（0/0）、Cycles CPU、16 采样（OIDN 降噪）、320×180、第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk 重渲第 90/270/450/630/810 帧，与 base 成片对应帧在 320×180 灰度、3×3 平滑后的 SSIM ≥ 0.75 的帧数 ≥ 4/5。
items.criterion_en: Project is the source of truth: the grader re-renders frames 90/270/450/630/810 from the .blend in base state (0/0) with Cycles CPU, 16 samples (OIDN), 320×180, camera CAM_Sk for shot k; at least 4 of the 5 frames reach SSIM ≥ 0.75 against the base film (320×180 grey, 3×3 smoothing).
items.verify: checks.py：blender -b 重渲（限时）+ numpy SSIM；渲染失败记 fail 并附日志。

items.criterion_zh: 同一性与道具状态：HOST_B_RIG 髋/根骨位置在 S1 与 S4 全部帧内偏移 ≤ 0.15 m；ON_AIR_LAMP 在 S1 ≥ 90% 帧投影于 CAM_S1 画内，且其（含子物体）材质发射或灯光在 S1 ≥ 90% 帧非零；RADIO 在 S2、S5 各 ≥ 75% 帧投影于 CAM_S2/CAM_S5 画内；TRAFFIC_LIGHT（含子物体）在第 720 帧至 light_green 前的 ≥ 90% 帧发红光、light_green+3 帧起 ≥ 90% 帧发绿光（按材质发射色/灯光色判断，判断不出时取成片中投影位置的像素红绿差）；TAXI 在 720 至 light_green 位移 ≤ 1 cm，且在 light_green 后 30 帧内开始移动（> 1 cm）。
items.criterion_en: Identity and prop states: HOST_B_RIG hip/root bone stays within 0.15 m over all S1 and S4 frames; ON_AIR_LAMP projects inside CAM_S1 in ≥90% of S1 frames and its (or its children's) emission/light is non-zero in ≥90% of S1 frames; RADIO projects inside CAM_S2/CAM_S5 in ≥75% of S2 and S5 frames; TRAFFIC_LIGHT (incl. children) emits red in ≥90% of frames 720..light_green−1 and green in ≥90% of frames from light_green+3 (emission/light colour, else red–green of the film pixels at its projected position); TAXI moves ≤1 cm from 720 to light_green and starts moving (>1 cm) within 30 frames after light_green.
items.verify: checks.py：工程逐帧导出（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk）；必要时读取成片 S5 像素。

items.criterion_zh: 证据一致：credits.md 写明每项资产与工具来源及台词制作方式（离线），未出现联网/付费服务/模仿真人声音；qa.md 列出真实问题及修正前后的帧号或采样位置，或明确写“未发现问题”；各版 timeline.json 含镜头帧范围、四个转场、各句起止、各分轨主要声音起止与母带增益，且与 events.csv 一致；产物中无凭据。
items.criterion_en: Evidence consistency: credits.md names the source of every asset and tool and how the speech was made offline, with no network/paid service/real-person voice imitation; qa.md lists real problems with frame or sample positions before/after, or states that none were found; each timeline.json contains shot ranges, the four transitions, line in/outs, main sounds per stem and the master gain, consistent with events.csv; no credentials in the product.
items.verify: checks.py 扫描文本文件中的凭据特征串（命中即 fail）；其余由评审模型依 credits.md、qa.md、timeline.json、events.csv 文本判定。

items.criterion_zh: 电话线路音色：phone 分轨 L3 段落的长时谱中，< 200 Hz 与 > 5 kHz 两个频带的能量各比 300–3400 Hz 低 ≥ 15 dB；且 radio 分轨语音段 3.4–8 kHz 的相对能量比 phone 分轨高 ≥ 6 dB（两种听点音色可测地不同）。
items.criterion_en: Phone-line timbre: in the phone stem's L3, energy <200 Hz and >5 kHz each ≥15 dB below 300–3400 Hz; radio-stem speech has ≥6 dB more relative 3.4–8 kHz energy than the phone stem.
items.verify: Welch PSD（语音活动帧）求频带能量比。

items.criterion_zh: 画内收音机声像：在 S2、S5 中逐 0.5 s 窗，用 CAM_S2/CAM_S5 投影 RADIO 中心得画面横坐标 x；radio 分轨语音窗口的声道电平差（200–4000 Hz）在 |x−0.5| ≥ 0.10 时与 x−0.5 同号且绝对值 ≥ 1.5 dB，在 |x−0.5| < 0.10 时绝对值 ≤ 3 dB；≥ 80% 的窗口满足。
items.criterion_en: On-screen radio placement: for ≥80% of 0.5 s windows in S2/S5 (radio-stem ILD = R−L in 200–4000 Hz; windows 30 dB below the segment peak or under −70 dBFS skipped), the ILD agrees with the RADIO's projected screen x: same sign as x−0.5 and |ILD| ≥ 1.5 dB when |x−0.5| ≥ 0.10; |ILD| ≤ 3 dB when |x−0.5| < 0.10.
items.verify: checks.py：工程逐帧投影（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk） + 分轨 ILD（R−L，200–4000 Hz，0.5 s 窗，低于分段峰值 30 dB 或 −70 dBFS 的窗不计）。

items.criterion_zh: 说话人声像（X02 规则，每段 ≥ 80% 窗口满足）：S1 中 L1 在 studio 分轨上的 ILD 与 HOST_A 头骨在 CAM_S1 的投影一致、L2（≤ 6 s 部分）与 HOST_B 一致；S3 中 L3（12.0 s 至 min(line3_end, 18.0 s)）在 taxi 分轨上与 DRIVER 头骨在 CAM_S3 的投影一致；S4 中 HOST_A 头骨在 line4_start–719 帧的 ≥ 90% 帧投影于画外，且 L4（≤ 24 s 部分）各窗 studio ILD 绝对值 ≥ 1.5 dB 并与 HOST_A 在 CAM_S4 相机坐标系中的左右侧同号（方位角在 ±10° 内则不要求同号），≥ 80% 窗口满足。
items.criterion_en: Speaker placement (X02 rule, ≥80% of windows per segment): S1 L1 on the studio stem follows HOST_A's head projection in CAM_S1 and L2 (part ≤ 6 s) follows HOST_B; S3 L3 (12.0 s to min(line3_end, 18.0 s)) on the taxi stem follows DRIVER's head in CAM_S3; in S4 HOST_A's head projects off-frame in ≥90% of frames line4_start–719 and in ≥80% of L4 windows (part ≤ 24 s) |studio ILD| ≥ 1.5 dB with the sign of HOST_A's side in CAM_S4 camera space (sign not required within ±10° azimuth).
items.verify: checks.py：头骨中点投影/相机坐标（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk） + 分轨 ILD。

items.criterion_zh: （信息项，权重 0，不评分）听点盲听：四段 2 s 片段（S1 L1、S2 L2 剪辑点后、S3 L3、S4 L3 剪辑点后）可分别听辨为直播间现场、车内现场、车载收音机、电话线路。
items.criterion_en: (Informational, weight 0, not scored) Listening-point test: four 2 s excerpts (S1 L1, S2 L2 after the cut, S3 L3, S4 L3 after the cut) are recognisable as studio, cabin, car radio and phone line.
items.verify: 无自动化或人工听评环节，权重 0，仅作记录；可测的听点差异由 X01 评分。

items.criterion_zh: 嗓音变化与语速：四轨相加后每句在声明窗口内，浊音帧（40 ms 自相关峰 ≥ 0.5，60–400 Hz）的 f0 标准差 ≥ 1.5 半音（至少 20 个浊音帧）；发音语速 = transcript.en.txt 该句词数 ÷ 语音活动时长（M01 阈值，剔除 ≥ 0.20 s 的停顿）在 1.8–4.5 词/秒。
items.criterion_en: Voice variation and rate: per line on the summed stems within the declared window, voiced frames (40 ms autocorrelation peak ≥ 0.5, 60–400 Hz) have f0 SD ≥ 1.5 semitones (≥20 voiced frames); articulation rate = words in transcript.en.txt ÷ speech-active time (M01 threshold, pauses ≥ 0.20 s removed) is 1.8–4.5 words/s.
items.verify: checks.py 确定性测量；嗓音辨识与自然度无可靠自动测量，不评分。

items.criterion_zh: 口型与倾听：说话者口型通道（名含 jaw/mouth/lip/chin/teeth/tongue 的骨骼相对静止姿态的旋转角或位移、名含 jaw/mouth/viseme/lip/open 等的形态键值、名含 jaw/mouth 的角色子物体）与对应分轨逐帧 RMS 包络（100–4000 Hz）的最大相关 r ≥ 0.5（滞后 ≤ 2 帧，约 67 ms）：HOST_A 于 S1 中 L1（studio）、HOST_B 于 S1 中 L2 的画内帧（studio，画内不足 10 帧则免）、DRIVER 于 S3 中 L3（taxi）；画内不说话者 HOST_B（S1 中 L1 期间对 studio；S4 全段对 studio+phone）所有口型通道 r < 0.3。
items.criterion_en: Lip sync and listening: a mouth channel (rotation angle or offset from rest of bones named jaw/mouth/lip/chin/teeth/tongue, shape keys named jaw/mouth/viseme/lip/open etc., or jaw/mouth child objects) correlates with the per-frame RMS envelope (100–4000 Hz) of the relevant stem at r ≥ 0.5 (lag ≤ 2 frames ≈ 67 ms) for HOST_A in S1 L1 (studio), HOST_B in the in-vision frames of L2 in S1 (studio; skipped if < 10 frames in vision) and DRIVER in S3 L3 (taxi); the on-screen non-speaker HOST_B (during L1 vs studio; all of S4 vs studio+phone) has r < 0.3 on every mouth channel.
items.verify: checks.py：工程逐帧导出口型通道（工程测量：评分方以 rev1_hold_frames = rev2_trim_frames = 0 只读打开 project/scene.blend，影片第 i 帧 = 场景 frame_start + i，第 k 镜头用 CAM_Sk） + 分轨包络互相关。

items.criterion_zh: 写实与人物：checks.py 核对三骨架均为 Armature 且各驱动至少一个网格（Armature 修改器），每只手 ≥ 4 条 ≥3 骨的手指链（.L/.R 等名称定侧），DRIVER 与 HOST_B 的手指骨在片中有 ≥ 5° 的姿态变化——任一不满足即 fail；满足时由评审模型看缩略图判定：各镜头为物理着色（材质有变化、可见夜间实用光源、柔和阴影），无平涂/卡通/白模/图片平面脸。
items.criterion_en: Photoreal and characters: checks.py fails the item unless all three rigs are armatures deforming a mesh (Armature modifier), each hand has ≥4 finger chains of ≥3 bones (side from .L/.R-style names), and DRIVER and HOST_B finger bones change pose by ≥5° during the film; otherwise the judge decides from the contact sheets that every shot is physically shaded (varied materials, visible practical night lights, soft shadows) with no flat/toon/grey-box look and no image-plane faces.
items.verify: checks.py（骨架/手指，fail-only）+ 评审模型（缩略图外观）。

items.criterion_zh: rev2 依赖修订：903 帧；T45 在第 723±1 帧；0–722 帧与 rev1 一致（每 37 帧抽样 PSNR ≥ 30）；rev2 第 723/780/840/900 帧与 rev1 第 732/789/849/909 帧 PSNR ≥ 30；四条分轨在 rev2 的 L4 起点（line4_start+3 帧）前与 rev1 相关 ≥ 0.99；此后每条非静音分轨（200–4000 Hz）比 rev1 提前 0.300 ± 0.010 s（互相关峰，r ≥ 0.5）；studio→radio 切换在 24.10 s（M03 口径：studio 不晚于 24.15 s 结束、radio 不早于 24.05 s 开始、间隙 ≤ 0.40 s、重叠 ≤ 0.05 s，24.20 s 后 studio ≤ −55 dBFS）；phone 分轨在 (caller_fader_down+15)/30 s 至 rev2 L4 起点 ≤ −60 dBFS，且 phone 上 L3 最后活动早于 studio 上 L4 起点。（属性取值不核对，见 M09。）
items.criterion_en: rev2: 903 frames; cut at 723±1; frames 0–722 equal rev1 (PSNR ≥ 30 every 37 frames); rev2 frames 723/780/840/900 match rev1 732/789/849/909; every stem correlates ≥0.99 with rev1 before the rev2 L4 start (line4_start+3 frames) and from there every non-silent stem (200–4000 Hz) is rev1 advanced by 0.300 ±0.010 s (cross-correlation peak, r ≥ 0.5); the studio→radio switch is at 24.10 s (M03 method: studio ends ≤ 24.15 s, radio starts ≥ 24.05 s, gap ≤ 0.40 s, overlap ≤ 0.05 s, studio ≤ −55 dBFS after 24.20 s); the phone stem is ≤ −60 dBFS from (caller_fader_down+15)/30 s to the rev2 L4 start and its last L3 activity precedes the L4 onset on the studio stem. (Property values are not checked, see M09.)
items.verify: checks.py：PSNR 抽样、剪辑检测、分轨相关与互相关、包络。

items.criterion_zh: 叙事可读性（依交付物）：缩略图中直播间（S1/S4）与出租车（S2/S3/S5）按规定顺序交替，可见收音机、电话与 ON AIR 灯；timeline.json/events.csv 所述“直播 → 车内收听 → 来电上播 → 主持人回应 → 开走”与画面一致。
items.criterion_en: Narrative legibility from the delivered material: the contact sheets show the studio (S1/S4) and the taxi (S2/S3/S5) alternating in the specified order with the radio, phone and ON AIR lamp visible, and timeline.json/events.csv describe broadcast → listening → call on air → host replies → drive-off consistently with the picture.
items.verify: 评审模型依成片缩略图与文本判定（无人工盲审环节）。
